title: Inspector smoke payload — minimal valid input for the elementor.convert.fidelity_check tool (post_id placeholder)
_comment: WP-H12 — Inspector smoke (14-fixtures-harness §8 step 3; 13-tool-catalog §1.9). convert.fidelity_check is read-only but RENDERS a SAVED page, so it needs a real post to point at: the §8 smoke runner CREATES a disposable draft in fixture setup, SUBSTITUTES its id into `arguments.post_id`, runs, then TRASHES the draft in teardown. PLACEHOLDER CONVENTION (documented): `arguments.post_id` is the SENTINEL 0; the runner MUST replace arguments.post_id (0) with the disposable draft id (the SAME draft convert.html_to_page would have written) before invoking — a smoke run against post_id:0 is expected to be substituted, never invoked literally. MINIMAL valid input per §1.9: `post_id` (int) + `source_html` (string); `breakpoints` optional. Skipped if the convert/persist capability is unavailable (capability-gated like every mutating-adjacent smoke, §8).
